newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks show bullish signs in technical chart.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks show bullish signs in technical chart.

text.p: The Japanese stock market's key Nikkei average and its December futures contract are showing bullish signs in their five-day and 25-day moving averages.
They have formed a so-called "golden cross" for the first time since August 20.
The Nikkei 225 average's five-day moving average stands at 20,745.56 as of the end of Tuesday trade, above its 25-day moving average of 20,717.69.
Its December futures' five-day moving average stands at 20,794, above its 25-day moving average of 20,760.
